subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"across."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Across"** means from one side to the other side of something. (एक ओर से दूसरी ओर; आर-पार)

 
 
• **Example:** *The bridge **across**__ the river was long and narrow.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it implies movement from one end to the other end of something.
 
• The correct answer is option 4.
 
• Correct passage:

The Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (DISHA) or National Digital Literacy Mission (NDLM) Scheme has been formulated to __impart__ IT training to 52.5 lakh persons, including Anganwadi and ASHA workers and authorised ration dealers in all the States/UTS __**across**__ the country so that the non-IT literate citizens are ______ (3) ______ to become IT literate so as to ______ (4) ______ them to actively and effectively participate in the democratic and developmental process and also ______ (5) ______ their livelihood.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Among**: implies being part of a group or surrounded by multiple options. (से घिरा हुआ; के बीच में)
 
• **Within**: implies something being inside or contained within a certain space or boundary. ((समयावधि की सीमा) के अंदर)
 
• **Between**: implies something being in the middle of two or more things or people. (दो वस्‍तुओं, व्‍यक्तियों, स्‍थानों आदि के बीच में; मध्य)

44:Tfc1,

The correct answer is **"trained."**
